summary: Backend + frontend testing complete for Rapportini di Lavoro. 25/25 pytest backend tests PASSED covering register/approve/login, cantieri CRUD & authorization, employee current-month report CRUD, admin edit stored separately (KEY business rule verified: employee /reports/mine still returns original values after admin edit), admin approve toggle, matrix, PDF/Excel export, admin user management (role, self-demote guard, delete). Frontend UI verified on mobile viewport (390x844): login (admin+employee), admin dashboard filters, matrix screen with export buttons, manage screen (users + cantieri tabs) with cantiere create, profile screen with theme toggle + logout, employee home + new-report-fab -> report-form (day chip, cantiere-select, hours-input, drove-switch, description-input, save-report-button) -> save -> report card appears with edit/delete actions -> delete confirm dialog. All flows working. Only minor React Native web console warnings (non-blocking).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: "shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow". Not breaking but should migrate. Occurs across screens; check theme/style files.
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: migrate deprecated RN web style props (shadow* -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents) to remove console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id via clean() and view functions. uuid string ids used throughout. Good.
admin_edit_report writes into admin_fields only; report_employee_view always uses original fields — KEY business rule enforced.
No hardcoded URLs; env vars used. JWT_SECRET from env.
server.py is ~610 lines — still manageable; consider splitting into routers/ if it grows.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_ prefixed users/cantieri/reports and cleanup after run. UI test seeded one employee via API and created one cantiere via UI (TEST_UI_bd0776 leftover — soft-deleted user leftover in DB, but excluded from listings).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://work-reports-9.preview.emergentagent.com; env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). pytest.ini enforces -n 2 --dist loadscope; module-shared state tests need loadscope to keep classes on one worker (works out-of-box). To run: `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Admin seed: admin@rapportini.it / Admin1234!. Server clock: Sept 2026.
